simple.meaning: צוּף (tsûwph) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to overflow.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 3 times across Deuteronomy, 2 Kings, Lamentations, beginning at Deuteronomy 11:4. Its contexts include Egypt.

firstOccurrence.englishText: and what he did to the army of Egypt, to their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red Sea to overflow them as they pursued you, and how Yahweh has destroyed them to this day;
